title: Campus hunting
content: I don't know if this dream was because I read here recently that there were tactical people in dreams, but I had one of those super realistic dreams in a nightmare world. There was a group of evil soldiers or assassins dressed in black, armed, who were hunting people. Almost everyone was trying to run away or hide. Another group seemed to be mentally controlled, meaning they were helping the soldiers. This was all happening at a university campusnwith gardens, a river, and many buildings no more than three stories high, but inside there were staircases leading down, with no exits, some ending in grates, and others going through water. To catch people, they threw a kind of thin, black, thorny organic tipe of chain at their feet or ankles that would hook into the skin. These chains were poisoned, because I saw some people running who started to fall because of the poison or something that made them fall asleep. I managed to pull mine off because I did it the same second it hooked onto my foot. I can say that the fear was palpable in that place, and there was no one to trust to get out of there. At some point, I think I got out onto a street, but there were those controlled people there. I escaped because I woke up, haha, otherwise I would still be hiding. What struck me most about the dream were the black, thorny chains, since I had never read about or seen anything like them in any movie or anywhere else. ChatGPT told me: "This doesn't come from a recognizable cultural image, which is why it's so impactful: the thin, organic, thorny, and poisonous black chains aren't a 'movie weapon,' they're a pure, almost archetypal dream image."
